acceptance.output_evidence: FOUR SEPARATE RECORDS, each naming axis / grain / one intent / state frame, each with its DECLARED LAYER stated explicitly and its uncovered member hunted. Declared layers, one per record and deliberately different: CONV-1 = every (holdings row x issuer feed) pair that can reach silver/holdings; CONV-2 = every non-null value appearing in the cusip column; CONV-3 = every (fund x date) partition-slice; T2-4 = every issuer feed that can produce a holdings row. GRAIN IS THE POSTULATE THAT DID REAL WORK: CONV-3 is per (fund x date) while CONV-1/CONV-2 are per row, and that is exactly WHY the conservation verdict is a MANIFEST field and not a row column -- a fund-level value beside a row-level value on one axis is the postulate-(ii) failure the rule exists to catch. UNCOVERED MEMBER HUNTED AND NAMED for CONV-1: a feed carrying its cash indicator in a SHARED or TYPED field (e.g. AssetClass='CASH') rather than a dedicated one would fall to vendor-silent, which would be WRONG because the vendor did say something; no such feed exists today (2 of 2 feeds checked) and its arrival is recorded as a re-authoring trigger rather than a silent stretch of vendor-silent. RULE 24(iii) APPLIED INSIDE VALUE WORDING, TWICE, AND IT CHANGED THE DESIGN: (a) I REJECT the TO's own sketched enum {vendor-flag, name-inferred, none} because `name-inferred` is a JUDGMENT and placing it on a SILVER provenance axis mixes what-the-vendor-said with what-we-concluded -- two intents on one axis, and it contradicts the TO's own constraint that THE INFERENCE STAYS IN GOLD (its real home is etf_positioning_gold.py:480-483 infer_is_cash()); (b) `none` fails inside its own wording -- it does not say WHAT is none (no cash? no basis? no vendor?). (c) For CONV-3 I deliberately did NOT use `reconciled`/`healthy`/`ok`, which assert a conclusion about correctness the axis cannot see; `within-tolerance` asserts only the measured relation. AND THE READING OF `vendor-silent` IS STATED so it is not misread: it asserts the FEED CARRIES NO SUCH FIELD, a structural fact about the header -- NOT that the vendor 'has no opinion', which would be an inference about the vendor.

mutant.description: Two mutant classes against the CONV-2 id_kind rule, each paired with positive controls on MEASURED live values -- because a harness that raises on everything proves nothing. (A) CHECK-DIGIT CORRUPTION: take the real live FXFXX CUSIP 31846V328 and corrupt ONLY its check digit (-> 31846V323), which is the typo-shaped mutant a consumer would actually produce rather than a nonsense string. (B) LENGTH MUTANTS on the BBG prefix at 11 and 13 chars. Run alongside a RULE MUTANT: classify_lengthonly(), the same classifier with the check digit removed, to test whether the check digit is load-bearing or decorative. SEPARATELY, the is_cash exercise carried its own three-arm control set (filepoint-only CONTROL / mixed UNDER TEST / all-None NEGATIVE CONTROL) through the estate's own _parquet_bytes shape and the REAL etf_daily_pull.py:88 expression. PLUS A NEGATIVE-CONTROL ARM, folded in here because the schema allows no separate key: The is_cash consumer exercise ran an all-None (TrueShares-only) arm alongside the filepoint-only arm, so the instrument is shown to discriminate rather than to raise indiscriminately. And the CONV-2 classification asserts total == row count. OBSERVED: filepoint-only arm does NOT raise and derives a clean universe; mixed and all-None arms BOTH raise TypeError. The classification totals 7,892 == 7,892 rows, verified as an assertion in the script rather than by eye, so the four values are exhaustive by measurement.
mutant.expected: each injected defect must reclassify away from the value it corrupts, each positive control must classify as measured on the live data, and the rule mutant must show whether removing the check digit changes any answer.
mutant.observed: 6 of 6 behaved as declared. Mutant A: 31846V323 -> unclassified (CAUGHT), while classify_lengthonly() still calls it `cusip` -- so the check digit IS load-bearing against corruption. Mutant B: BBG at len 11 and len 13 -> unclassified, not claimed as bbgid. 4 of 4 positive controls pass on measured live values (31846V328 -> cusip, BBG01Y2F01K3 -> bbgid, Cash&Other -> vendor-sentinel, CASHEUR -> unclassified). *** THE RESULT I AM RECORDING AGAINST MY OWN RULE: on the live population 7,674 of 7,674 nine-char values pass the check digit, so classify() and classify_lengthonly() return IDENTICAL output on today's data. The live read CANNOT discriminate the two rules. The check digit is therefore a PROSPECTIVE guard whose power is demonstrated ONLY by injection -- 'it agrees with the data' is not evidence that it works. *** AND A CONTROL OF MINE FAILED OPEN BEFORE I CAUGHT IT: the first positive control used a REMEMBERED constant (31846V336) rather than the MEASURED live value (31846V328). It PASSED, because 31846V336 is a different REAL CUSIP with its own valid check digit -- so a control testing a value that never appears in this dataset reported success and nothing flagged it. Found by re-reading the live cusip for FXFXX, corrected, re-run. An unmeasured exact constant failed OPEN while looking principled.

determinism.method: Every figure in this deliverable is re-derivable from three inputs that do not move: (a) the 72 silver/holdings parquet partitions, which are immutable once written -- the producer writes {run_date}.parquet once per day and the 08-23 object's LastModified has not changed across my reads; (b) the deployed converter's source at a named vintage; (c) pure-form classifiers (CUSIP check digit, length gates) with no clock, no network and no randomness. THE ONE NON-DETERMINISM IS NAMED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: the partition SET grows by one object per day at 22:00Z, so the row denominator 7,892 is AS-OF 2026-08-24 ~20:55Z and will be larger tomorrow. Every count in the deliverable is therefore stamped with its partition denominator (72) rather than quoted bare, so a later re-run that returns a different number is distinguishable from a contradiction.
determinism.observed: The 72-partition token walk and the 7,892-row concat were run twice in this session and returned identical figures both times; the id_kind classification totals 7,892 == 7,892 rows as a script ASSERTION rather than by eye, and date == data_as_of held on 7,892 of 7,892 rows on both reads.
